c-tuulia.headline: Writes about password reset, session handling and who they would tell
in_their_words: I would start with the password reset page, because reset links are often guessable or never expire.
In my university lab I broke a login by replaying a stolen session cookie, then wrote up how to stop it.
If I found a hole before a release I would tell the developers the same day and ask them to hold the release.

c-tuulia.headline: Writes about bug bounty reports, reading code first and repeatable write-ups

I read the code first and then try to break it, and I write down every step so the developers can repeat it.
